claims.verbatim: TEXEL, Aug 6—Arr J L Thierman, Noordenholt[?], Baltimore.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 23 August 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Texel, Aug 6—Capt Nordholdt, of the J L Tiermann[?], ar-
rived here from Baltimore, reports having seen July 25, lat
42 12[?], lon 41 W, the wreck of an English or American ship,
timber laden and dismasted, and on the 29th, lat 45 N, lon
30 14[?] W, the hull of a ship waterlogged painted black and
white.

claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 9 August 1866, p. 4, col. 3 (British Newspaper Archive)
